decision.prediction: Across tested input patterns, late rebounds will remain predictable from elapsed-time features together with accumulated input and state history.

mapping.target_relation: Elapsed-time and accumulated-history features jointly improve held-out prediction; this does not establish a physical mechanism.
mapping.condition_to_check: Poor forecasts on new input patterns or rebound timing that follows input history rather than elapsed time would weaken this relation.
